profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Cruise

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Used C, C++, Python, Docker and Redis to develop a tool that audits terminal and process data on Linux based systems. Appointed as team lead. Led design meetings and scrum activities.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Helped develop tools for a remote execution platform running on embedded devices. Used python and C to develop the tools in a Linux environment and tested the tools using pytest and cmock. Containerized the program using Docker.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software and unit tests for a customizable network traffic generation tool using object oriented python. Helped develop REST API endpoints for the traffic generator using the Django REST framework. Developed software in a Linux environment and within a Docker containerized environment. Utilized wireshark to analyze and verify the packets sent by the traffic generator.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on a project to integrate a propriety external location tracking firmware library into the QC35. Debugged and tested the changes to the firmware to ensure existing functionalities were not affected. Also, helped prototype a machine readable format using YAML for Bose’s network protocol word documentation. Developed a python script to generate a human readable Latex document from the YAML format. Created the system by using test driven development with unit-test cases.

positions.title: Rental Agent Intern and Camp Counselor
positions.description:
Enhanced and maintained filing and work orders systems
Answered phone calls and worked front desk, providing general information to customers
Assisted full time agents in completing daily tasks
Drafted incidence reports, weekly events and schedules, while maintaining records
Directed and supervised junior counselors, while leading group activities

honors.title: Benjamin A. Gilman Scholarship
honors.issuer: Issued by Institute of International Education · Oct 2016

projects.title: Microelectronics I/II
projects.description: Worked with diodes and transistors to analyze their operations and performances. Designed an audio amplifier circuit by combining a differential pair, a Common-Emitter, and an emitter follower circuit. Designed with nonlinear and mixed signal circuits. Identified and mitigated the static and dynamic effects of non-ideal behaviors of op-amps.

projects.title: Real-time Embedded System Design
projects.description: Created a single channel digital oscilloscope and spectrum analyzer by using a Stellaris microcontroller on the ARM Cortex-M3. Initially considered tight timing constraints by using interrupt prioritization and preemption, then later ported the code to a SYS/BIOS RTOS. Added a frequency meter to the system by using a LM3S2110 to read data from its comparator. Transmitted the data between boards through a CAN bus.
